scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c auto "corepack pnpm --filter @app/api dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @app/web dev"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @app/api build && corepack pnpm --filter @app/web build
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter @app/api lint && corepack pnpm --filter @app/web lint
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @app/api typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @app/web typecheck
